name: cf-media-parser
description: 三平台媒体解析工具（抖音/快手/B站）— Cloudflare Workers + Pages，零成本部署，无需登录

scripts.build:dist: npm run build && npm run copy:dist
scripts.check: node tests/check.mjs && node tests/check-parsers.mjs && node tests/test-parsers.mjs && node tests/test-render.mjs && node tests/test-top3.mjs
scripts.test: node tests/test-parsers.mjs && node tests/test-render.mjs && node tests/test-top3.mjs
